The `AnthropicModel` type definition remains derived from these constants, ensuring type safety for the new model string.

eli5.text: When you ask the assistant to use its standard, mid-tier reasoning mode, it will now use the latest version of that model (Claude 3.7 Sonnet) instead of the previous version (Claude 3.5 Sonnet). This change is already in place today, so any request routed to that default mode is automatically using the newer model. Other modes and configurations are unaffected.

ai.title: System prompt: forbid touch for file creation
ai.summary: backend/src/system-prompt.ts editingFilesPrompt section header renamed to 'Editing or creating files' and new constraint added: do not create files via terminal command like `touch`. Mechanism: instructs agent to use edit_file block with full content and new path instead. Scope: backend system prompt only. Typo 'terminial' preserved in source.

eli5.text: The instructions given to the assistant were slightly broadened so that the assistant now treats creating a new file and editing an existing one as the same kind of action. As a result, you (the person reading this note) would notice nothing different while working, unless you watched closely: the assistant will stop suggesting you create files through terminal-style commands like `touch`, and instead do it through its normal built-in file editing steps. This change only lives inside the backend system prompt, and it is already in place and active today.
